overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long RDDT Daily ETF (RDTL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Reddit, Inc. (RDDT) stock. RDTL was launched on Mar 25, 2025 and is issued by GraniteShares.
